statement: Pinned controller-family Bluetooth notes identify simple HID mode input 0x3F before subcommand 0x03 selects full input mode 0x30; simple mode publishes on input changes. The notes do not establish a physical Switch Pro default after every connection or a verified simple-report descriptor.

applicability.revision: Pinned Linux 4056b3c, SDL 535d80b and/or community b354f21 as cited; retail firmware not measured
applicability.scope: Community bluetooth_hid_subcommands_notes.md 66-83; transport mode description only; default and timing need a physical trace.
